Saqhekeza imithombo emhlabeni, amanzi [angaphansi naphezulu] ahlanganela kumyalelo onqunyiwe.

Ingabe laba abangakholwa benu bangcono yini kunalabo kumbe ninesiqiseko sokuphepha esilotshwe eZincwadini zaphambilini na?
Kumbe bathi: “Sibaningi siyonqoba”.
Lizonqotshwa iningi libaleke.
Empeleni iSikhathi [sokwahlulelwa] yisona ababekelwe sona futhi iSikhathi sinzima kakhulu futhi sibuhlungu kakhulu.
Impela izephula mthetho zidukile futhi ziyongena emlilweni.
Ngosuku lapho beyohudulelwa emlilweni ngobuso babo, [kuthiwe]: “Zwanini ubunzima womlilo”.
Futhi yonke into siyidale seyinqunyelwe.
Futhi umyalelo weThu uwodwa vo, njengophazima kweso.
Futhi sababhubhisa abafana nani; ingabe ukhona ozothatha isifundo.
Yonke into abayenzile ilotshiwe eZincwadini zaphambilini.
Futhi yonke into encane nenkulu [abayenzayo] iqoshiwe.
Impela laba abathobela u Allah bayongena ezivandeni nasemifuleni.
